candidate.title: CATCH-IT
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina CATCH-IT schematic, from cellular methionine starvation and AHA metabolic labeling through biotin coupling, MNase digestion, streptavidin-associated H3/H4–DNA enrichment and DNA extraction. CATCH-IT expands to Covalent Attachment of Tags to Capture Histones and Identify Turnover; the far-left nucleosome/title icon is an overview, not a second input or workflow branch. The matching collection page identifies this as a schematic overview of CATCH-IT. No alternative target method is depicted. Scope ends at extracted DNA; associated library-preparation kits and unshown pulse/chase experiments are not added as operations.
